versions.changelog: 改名为功能词优先（公众号排版/小红书封面），避免与原版 Inkwell 撞名并提升搜索可见性

- Added supply chain documentation (`SUPPLY_CHAIN.md`) to support reproducible builds and audit.
- Removed `skill-card.md`.
- Added detailed supply chain audit, SBOM, and wheel hash verification instructions to installation docs in SKILL.md.
- Recommended locking transitive dependencies using pip-compile with hash.
- Clarified that this Skill only provides documentation, advising to audit the actual `inkwell-press` implementation before install.

- Removed the documentation file skill-card.md.
- No functional or user-facing changes; only documentation cleanup.

- Clarified handling of external (remote) images: by default, the run command will download and embed external images for local previews, which triggers outbound requests; added guidance and the --no-embed-external flag to disable this behavior for offline/private environments.
- Updated safety and data handling section to explicitly describe outbound network behavior when processing external images.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file for a cleaner package.
- Usage instructions now highlight network implications and best practices for controlling data flow, making external image handling more transparent to users.

- Added PUBLISH.md and requirements.txt files for documentation and safer installation guidance.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Updated installation instructions to recommend version pinning and hash verification for better supply chain security.
- Provided explicit data flow and safety instructions, ensuring users are informed before any external data transmission.
- Clarified when skill actions should (and should not) be triggered.
- No functional changes to inkwell tool itself; changes focus on documentation, safety, and usage guidelines.

Initial release of inkwell-press.

- 全链路内容发布工具：支持 Markdown 到公众号 HTML 排版，图片处理，生成杂志封面与社交卡片，一键发布到剪贴板或公众号草稿箱
- 提供 13 大核心命令，涵盖排版、发布、封面与卡片生成、内容生成、敏感词、目录、统计等
- 丰富主题支持，满足多种内容风格（15 套主题可选）
- 支持图片外链、基于 GitHub + jsDelivr 配置、与微信公众号编辑器兼容性处理
- 提供详细的使用场景示例与环境变量说明
